experimental_design.evidence: inferred: By analyzing the atg8 mutants, we found that in contrast to mammalian ATG8s, in which the LC3s and GABARAP subfamilies play distinct roles in the autophagic process, Arabidopsis ATG8s perform an overlapping function in controlling autophagic flux.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: To assess the roles of ATG8 genes in plant autophagy, here we used CRISPR/Cas9 technology to systematically knockout the Arabidopsis ATG8 genes.
